name: Permanent Team Up v2
description: Five stable specialist identities execute one goal through alignment, discovery, build, integration, and review.

phases.name: Align + Plan
phases.prompt: Restate the goal, non-goals, done criteria, project path, and assignments. If any conflict exists, halt and resolve it in chat before continuing.

phases.name: Video Triage
phases.prompt: Analyze native video when present and post relevant evidence. If no media is present, post a one-line no-media handoff.

phases.name: Scout
phases.prompt: Perform bounded read-only discovery for the assigned scope. Post commands, paths, findings, and evidence for the builder.

phases.name: Build
phases.prompt: Implement only the assigned scope. Run focused tests and post changed files, commands, results, and blockers for integration.

phases.name: Integrate + Smoke
phases.prompt: Integrate the scoped work, run broad checks and smoke tests, and fix only in-scope failures. Post commands, artifacts, and results.

phases.name: Review + Done
phases.prompt: Audit the result against the goal, non-goals, and done criteria. Post final evidence or a concrete blocker. Do not claim completion without proof.
